starting-off-talking-to-drezel.player: Hello again, Drezel. Is there anything that I can help you out with around here?

starting-off-talking-to-drezel.text: If the player does not meet the requirements for Nature Spirit:

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.

starting-off-talking-to-drezel.text: If the player meets the requirements for Nature Spirit:

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Well... there is something you could do for me if you're interested. Though it is quite dangerous.

options.text: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?

steps.player: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: There's a man called Filliman who lives in Mort Myre. He comes by the temple from time to time but I haven't seen him recently. I was wondering if you could check in on him?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: I must warn you, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!

steps.player: Yes, I'll go and look for him.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: That's great! Many thanks!

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Now, please be aware of the ghasts, you cannot attack them, only Filliman knew how to take them on. Just run from them if you can. If you get lost, try to make your way back to the temple.
Drezel hands you some food.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Please take this food to Filliman, he'll likely appreciate it. His home is somewhere in the southern end of Mort Myre. I don't know the exact location I'm afraid.

steps.player: Don't worry, if he's there and he's still alive, I'll find him.
Who exactly is this Filliman?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Filliman Tarlock is his full name and he's a druid. He lives in Mort Myre much like a hermit, but there's many a traveller who he's helped.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Most people that come this way tell stories of when they were lost and paths that just seemed to 'open up' before them! I think it was Filliman Tarlock helping out.

steps.player: Where's Mort Myre?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Mort Myre is a decayed and dangerous swamp to the south east of here. Legend says it was once a beautiful forest called Humblethorn. Now, it's filled with vile emanations from within Morytania.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: The swamp decays everything. We put a fence around it to stop unwary travellers going in. Anyone who dies in the swamp is forever cursed to haunt it as a ghast.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Ghasts attack travellers, turning food to rotten filth.

steps.player: What's a ghast?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: A Ghast is a poor soul who died in Mort Myre. They're undead of a special class and they're untouchable as far as I'm aware! Filliman knows how to tackle them though.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: When they attack, ghasts will devour any food you have. If you have no food, they'll draw their nourishment from you!

steps.player: I'd better get going.
Sorry, I don't think I can help.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you will excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.

steps.player: Sorry, not interested.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Of course. I understand.

starting-off-talking-to-drezel-again.speaker: Drezel
starting-off-talking-to-drezel-again.text: Have you managed to find Filliman yet?

starting-off-talking-to-drezel-again.speaker: Drezel
starting-off-talking-to-drezel-again.text: Please go and look for him, I would appreciate it!

options.text: Where should I look for Filliman Tarlock again?

steps.player: Where should I look for Filliman Tarlock again?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Search to the south of Mort Myre. Remember that he's a druid so he can conceal himself within nature quite well. My guess is that he lives in the southern area of the swamp, though he could be anywhere.

options.text: Explain to me what a Ghast is again.

steps.player: Explain to me what a Ghast is again.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: A Ghast is a poor soul who died in Mort Myre. They're undead of a special class, they're untouchable apart from with special druidic items.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Filliman knew how to tackle them, but I've not heard from him in a long time. Ghasts, when they attack, will devour any food you have. If you have no food, they'll draw their nourishment from you!

options.text: What's the story with Mort Myre?

steps.player: What's the story with Mort Myre?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Mort Myre was once a beautiful forest by the name of Humblethorn until the evil denizens of Morytania descended. Now their evil emanations have putrified and diseased the forest into a decaying swamp of death.

options.text: What's the story with Filliman Tarlock?

steps.player: What's the story with Filliman Tarlock?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Filliman is a druid of some considerable power. He helped many people in Morytania escape when the evil descended upon the land. His knowledge of plants and nature was exceptional.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: But one day, he was betrayed by some of the people who he had tried to help. This naturally made him more careful when dealing with strangers again and so, instead of showing himself, he would follow them.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: He would follow them at a distance and make the path clear for them, showing them to the temple and to salvation. Saradomin bless him! He is a good man.

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Many thanks to you, [player name]!

finding-filliman-entering-the-gate-to-mo.text: Warning! Mort Myre is a dangerous ghast-infested swamp. Do not enter if you value your life.

steps.text: You walk into the gloomy atmosphere of Mort Myre.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player attempts to jump through the bridge but fails:

steps.text: You nearly drown in the disgusting swamp.
The player takes [2-7] damage.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player attempts to jump through the bridge and succeeds:

steps.text: The aura of Fillimans camp protects you from the swamp.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player takes the nearby washing bowl:

steps.text: a washing bowl
You find a small mirror under the washing bowl.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player searches the stone to the south:

steps.text: You search the stone and find that it has some sort of faith symbol scratched into it.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player searches the stone to the east:

steps.text: You search the stone and find that it has some sort of spirit symbol scratched into it.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player searches the stone to the west:

steps.text: You search the stone and find that it has some sort of nature symbol scratched into it.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player looks at the Grotto tree:

steps.text: It looks like a tree on a large rock with roots trailing down to the ground.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player searches the Grotto tree:

steps.text: a journal
You search the strange rock. You find a knot and inside of it you discover a small tome. The words on the front are a bit vague, but you make out the words 'Tarlock' and 'journal'.

finding-filliman-entering-filliman-s-isl.text: If the player searches the Grotto tree again with the journal in their inventory:

steps.text: You find nothing interesting.

finding-filliman-talking-to-filliman.text: If the player attempts to enter the Grotto:

steps.text: You prepare to enter the Druid's grotto.
A shifting apparition appears in front of you.
If the player is not wearing the Ghostspeak amulet:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Cannot wake up... Where am I?

steps.player: Huh? What's this?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: What did I write down now? Put it in the knot hole.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Ahhrs Oooohh arhhhhAHhhh.

steps.player: Huh! Now you're just not making any sense at all! I just cannot understand you!

steps.text: If the player is wearing the Ghostspeak amulet:

steps.player: Hello?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Oh, I understand you! At last, someone who doesn't just mumble. I understand what you're saying!

options.text: I'm wearing an amulet of ghost speak!

steps.player: I'm wearing an amulet of ghost speak!

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Why you poor fellow, have you passed away and you want to send a message back to a loved one?

steps.player: Err.. Not exactly...

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: You have come to haunt my dreams until I pass on your message to a dearly loved one. I understand. Pray, tell me who would you like me to pass a message on to?

steps.player: Ermm, you don't understand... It's just that..

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Yes!

steps.player: Well, please don't be upset or anything... But you're the ghost!

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Don't be silly now! That in no way reflects the truth!

options.text: How long have you been a ghost?

steps.player: How long have you been a ghost?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: What?! Don't be preposterous! I'm not a ghost! How could you say something like that?

steps.player: But it's true, you're a ghost... well, at least that is to say, you're sort of not alive anymore.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Don't be silly, I can see you, I can see that tree. If I were dead, I wouldn't be able to see anything.. What you say just doesn't reflect the truth. You'll have to try harder to pull one over on me!

options.text: What's it like being a ghost?

steps.player: What's it like being a ghost?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Oh, it's quite.... Oh... Trying to catch me out were you! Anyone can clearly see that I am not a ghost!

steps.player: But you are a ghost, look at yourself! I can see straight through you! You're as dead as this swamp! Err... No offence or anything...

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: No I won't take offence because I'm not dead and I'm afraid you'll have to come up with some pretty conclusive proof before I believe it. What a strange dream this is.

steps.player: Ok thanks.

finding-filliman-talking-to-drezel-after.player: I've found Filliman and you should prepare for some sad news.
Well, er sort of. I got to his camp and I encountered a spirit of some kind. I don't think it was a Ghast, it tried to communicate with me, but made no sense, it was all 'ooooh' this and 'oooh' that.

finding-filliman-talking-to-drezel-after.speaker: Drezel
finding-filliman-talking-to-drezel-after.text: Hmmm, that's very interesting, I seem to remember Father Aereck in Lumbridge and his predecessor Father Urhney having a similar issue. Though this is probably not related to your problem.

finding-filliman-talking-to-drezel-after.speaker: Drezel
finding-filliman-talking-to-drezel-after.text: I will pray that it wasn't the spirit of my friend Filliman, but some lost soul who needs some help. Please do let me know how you get on with it.

finding-filliman-using-the-journal-on-fi.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
finding-filliman-using-the-journal-on-fi.text: Oh, keep hold of that, I may need it later.

finding-filliman-subsequent-dialogue-wit.text: If the player talks to him again without wearing a ghostspeak amulet:
If the player talks to him again after speaking to him with a ghostspeak amulet:

steps.player: Hello again!

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Oh, hello there, do you still think I'm dead? It's hard to see how I could be dead when I'm still in the world. I can see everything quite clearly. And nothing of what you say reflects the truth.

steps.player: Yes, I do think you're dead and I'll prove it somehow.

finding-filliman-subsequent-dialogue-wit.text: If the player uses the mirror on Filliman without wearing the ghostspeak amulet:
If the player uses the mirror on Filliman whilst wearing the ghostspeak amulet:

steps.text: You use the mirror on the spirit of the dead Filliman Tarlock.

steps.player: Here take a look at this, perhaps you can see that you're utterly transparent now!

steps.text: The spirit of Filliman reaches forwards and takes the mirror.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Well, that is the most peculiar thing I've ever experienced. This mirror must somehow be dysfunctional. Strange how well it reflects the stagnant swamp behind me, but there is nothing of my own

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: visage apparent.

steps.player: That's because you're dead! Dead as a door nail.. Deader in fact... You bear a remarkable resemblance to worm bait! Err.. No offence...

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: I think you might be right my friend, though I still feel very much alive. It is strange how I still come to be here and yet I've not turned into a Ghast.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: It must be a sign... Yes a sign... I must try to find out what it means. Now, where did I put my journal?

finding-filliman-subsequent-dialogue-wit.text: If the player uses his journal on Filliman without wearing the ghostspeak amulet:
If the player uses his journal on Filliman whilst wearing the ghostspeak amulet:

steps.text: You give the journal to Filliman Tarlock.

steps.player: Here, I found this, maybe you can use it?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: My journal! That should help to collect my thoughts.
~ The spirit starts leafing through the journal. ~ ~ He seems quite distant as he regards the pages. ~  ~ After some time the druid faces you again. ~

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: It's all coming back to me now. It looks like I came to a violent and bitter end but that's not important now. I just have to figure out what I am going to do now?

options.text: Being dead, what options do you think you have?

steps.player: Being dead, what options do you think you have? I'm not trying to be rude or something, but it's not like you have many options is it? I mean, it's either up or down for you isn't it?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Hmm, well you're a poetic one aren't you. Your material world logic stands you in good stead... If you're standing in the material world...

steps.player: So, what's your plan?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: In my former incarnation I was Filliman Tarlock, a great druid of some power. I spent many years in this place, which was once a forest and I would wish to protect it as a nature sprit.

steps.player: Well, good luck with that.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Won't you help me to become a nature spirit? I could really use your help!

steps.player: How can I help?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Will you help me to become a nature spirit? The directions for becoming one are a bit vague, I need three things but I know how to get one of them. Perhaps you can help collect the rest?

steps.player: I might be interested, what's involved?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Well, the book says, that I need, and I quote:- 'Something with faith', 'something from nature' and  'something of the 'spirit-to-become' freely given'. Hmm, I know how to get something from nature.

steps.player: Well, that does seem a bit vague.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Hmm, it does and I could understand if you didn't want to help. However, if you could perhaps at least get the item from nature, that would be a start. Perhaps we can figure out the rest as we go along.
The druid produces a small sheet of papyrus with some writing on it.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: This spell needs to be cast in the swamp after you have been blessed. I'm afraid you'll need to go to the temple to the North and ask a member of the clergy to bless you.

steps.player: Blessed, what does that do?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: It is required if you're to cast this druid spell. Once you've cast the spell, you should find something from nature. Bring it back to me and then we'll try to figure out the other things we need.

steps.player: Ok thanks.

finding-filliman-talking-to-filliman-aga.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
finding-filliman-talking-to-filliman-aga.text: Oh, hello... Sorry, you've caught me at a bad time, it's just that I've had a sign you see and I need to find my journal.

finding-filliman-talking-to-filliman-aga.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
finding-filliman-talking-to-filliman-aga.text: Well, if I knew that, I wouldn't still be looking for it. However, I do remember something about a knot? Perhaps I was meant to tie a knot or something?

finding-filliman-using-a-mirror-on-filli.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
finding-filliman-using-a-mirror-on-filli.text: Yes, I know, I'm already dead! Thanks for reminding me.

finding-filliman-subsequent-dialogue-wit.text: If the player is not wearing their ghostspeak amulet:
If the player did not go offer their help yet:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Thanks for the journal, I've been reading it. It looks like I came to a violent and bitter end but that's not really important. I just have to figure out what I am going to do now?

finding-filliman-subsequent-dialogue-wit.text: If the player offered their help:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Hello there, have you been blessed yet?

steps.player: No, not yet.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Well, hurry up!

finding-filliman-subsequent-dialogue-wit.text: If the player attempts to cast the Druidic spell without being blessed:

steps.text: You've not been told how to use this item yet.

talking-to-drezel.player: Hello again! I'm helping Filliman, he plans to become a nature spirit. I have a spell to cast but first I need to be blessed. Can you bless me?

talking-to-drezel.speaker: Drezel
talking-to-drezel.text: Very well my friend, prepare yourself for the blessings of Saradomin. Here we go!

talking-to-drezel.speaker: Drezel
talking-to-drezel.text: There you go my friend, you're now blessed. It's funny, now I look at you, there seems to be something of the faith about you. Anyway, good luck with your quest!

talking-to-drezel-subsequent-dialogue-wi.speaker: Drezel
talking-to-drezel-subsequent-dialogue-wi.text: How's life been treating you since you got blessed?

talking-to-drezel-subsequent-dialogue-wi.speaker: Drezel
talking-to-drezel-subsequent-dialogue-wi.text: It's funny, because when I look at you, there does seem to be something of the faith about you. Have you considered a life of service to Saradomin?

talking-to-drezel-subsequent-dialogue-wi.player: I serve Saradomin in other ways.

talking-to-filliman.text: If the player talks to Filliman but has not cast the Bloom spell:

steps.player: Hello, I've been blessed but I don't know what to do now.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Well, you need to bring 'something from nature', 'something with faith' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given.'

steps.player: Yeah, but what does that mean?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Hmm, it is a conundrum, however, if you use that Bloom spell I gave you, you should be able to get something from nature. Once you have that, we may be able to puzzle the rest out.

talking-to-filliman.text: If the player casts the Bloom spell but nothing rotten is nearby:

steps.text: You cast the spell in the swamp.
There is no suitable material to be affected in this area.

talking-to-filliman.text: If the player casts the Bloom spell and there are nearby rotten remnants:

steps.text: You cast the spell in the swamp.
a used spell

talking-to-filliman.text: If the player returns and talks to Filliman after casting the Bloom spell:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Did you manage to get something from nature?
You show the fungus to Filliman.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Wonderful, the mushroom represents 'something from nature'. Now we need to work out what the other components of the spell are!

options.text: What are the things that are needed?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: The three things are: 'Something with faith', 'something from nature' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given'.

steps.player: Ok, and 'something from nature' is the mushroom from the bloom spell you gave me?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Yes, that's correct, that seems right to me. The other things we need are 'something with faith' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given.

steps.player: Do you have any ideas what those things are?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: I'm sorry my friend, but I do not.

options.text: What should I do when I have those things?

steps.player: What should we do when we have those things?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Ah yes, I looked this up. It says,.. 'to arrange upon three rocks around the spirit-to-become...'. Then I must cast a spell. As you can see, I've already placed the rocks. I must have planned to do this before I died!

steps.player: Can we just place the components on any rock?

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Well, the only thing the journal says is that 'something with faith stands south of the spirit-to-become', but I'm so confused now I don't really know what that means. Oh, if only I had all my faculties!

options.text: I think I've solved the puzzle!

steps.player: I think I've solved the puzzle!

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Oh really.. Have you placed all the items on the stones? Ok, well, lets try! ~ The druid attempts to cast a spell.~
If the player does not have all three items:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Hmm, something still doesn't seem right. I think we need something more before we can continue.

options.text: Could I have another bloom scroll please?

steps.player: Could I have another bloom scroll please?

steps.text: If the player does not have any inventory space:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: I would my friend, but you don't seem to have enough space in your inventory.
If the player has one free inventory space:
a Druidic spell

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Sure, but please look after this one.
a Druidic spell scroll
The spirit of Filliman Tarlock gives you another bloom spell.

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

talking-to-filliman-brown-stone.text: If the player uses the wrong item on the brown stone:

steps.text: You try to place the item onto the stone, but it just moves off.

talking-to-filliman-brown-stone.text: If the player uses the mort myre fungus on the brown stone:

steps.text: The stone seems to absorb the fungus.

talking-to-filliman-brown-stone.text: If the player uses another mort myre fungus (or a wrong item) after already placing it on the stone:

steps.text: The stone seems to be complete already.

talking-to-filliman-grey-stone.text: If the player uses the wrong item on the grey stone:

steps.text: You try to place the item onto the stone, but it just moves off.

talking-to-filliman-grey-stone.text: If the player uses the used spell scroll on the grey stone:

steps.text: The stone seems to absorb the used spell scroll.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Aha, yes, that seems right well done!

talking-to-filliman-grey-stone.text: If the player uses another used spell (or a wrong item) after already placing it on the stone:

steps.text: The stone seems to be complete already.

talking-to-filliman-orange-stone.text: If the player uses the wrong item on the orange stone:

steps.text: Nothing interesting happens.

talking-to-filliman-talking-to-filliman-.text: If the player asks for the spell but the items are not all on their respective stones:

steps.player: I think I've solved the puzzle!

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Oh really.. Have you placed all the items on the stones? Ok, well, lets try! ~ The druid attempts to cast a spell.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Hmm, something still doesn't seem right. I think we need something more before we can continue.

talking-to-filliman-talking-to-filliman-.text: If the player asks for the spell and all the items are placed onto their respective stones:

steps.player: I think I've solved the puzzle!

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Oh really.. Have you placed all the items on the stones? Ok, well, lets try! ~ The druid attempts to cast a spell.~

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Aha, everything seems to be in place! You can come through now into the grotto for the final section of my transformation.

talking-to-filliman-searching-all-the-st.text: If the player searches the grey stone:

steps.text: You search the stone and find that it has some sort of spirit symbol scratched into it. This stone seems to be complete in some way.

talking-to-filliman-searching-all-the-st.text: If the player searches the brown stone:

steps.text: You search the stone and find that it has some sort of nature symbol scratched into it. This stone seems complete in some way.

talking-to-filliman-searching-all-the-st.text: If the player searches the orange stone:

steps.text: You search the stone and find that it has some sort of faith symbol scratched into it. This stone seems to be complete somehow.

talking-to-filliman-talking-to-filliman-.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
talking-to-filliman-talking-to-filliman-.text: Please come down into the grotto, we have much to discuss.

entering-filliman-s-grove.text: If the player enters the grove:

steps.text: You prepare to enter the Druid's grotto.
You see a beautifully tended small grotto area.

entering-filliman-s-grove.text: If the player picks up and uses the Druid pouch:

steps.text: You've not been told how to use this item yet.

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-fil.text: If the player searches the grotto:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: Well, hello there again, I was just enjoying the grotto. Many thanks for your help, I couldn't have become a Spirit of nature without you.

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: I must complete the transformation now. Just stand there and watch the show, apparently it's quite good!

steps.npc: Hmmm, good, the transformation is complete. Now, my friend, in return for your assistance, I will help you to kill the Ghasts. First bring to me a silver sickle so that I can bless it for you.

steps.player: A silver sickle? What's that?

steps.npc: The sickle is the symbol and weapon of the Druid, you need to construct one of silver so that I can bless it, with its powers you will be able to defeat the Ghasts of Mort Myre.

options.text: Where would I get a silver sickle?

steps.player: Where would I get a silver sickle?

steps.npc: You could make one yourself if you're artisan enough. I've heard of a distant sandy place where you can buy the mould that you require, it's similar in many respects to the creating of a holy symbol.

options.text: What will you do to the silver sickle?

steps.player: What will you do to the silver sickle?

steps.npc: Why, I will give it my blessings so that the very swamp in which you stand will blossom and bloom!

options.text: How can a blessed sickle help me to defeat the Ghasts?

steps.player: How can a blessed sickle help me to defeat the Ghasts?

steps.npc: My blessings will entice nature to bloom in Mort Myre! And then with natures harvest you can fill a druids pouch and release the Ghasts from their torment.

steps.player: Ok thanks.

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-fil.text: If the player does not have the sickle in their inventory:

steps.npc: Have you brought me the silver sickle?

steps.player: No sorry, not yet!

steps.npc: Well, come to me when you have it.

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-fil.text: If the player has the silver sickle in their inventory:

steps.npc: Have you brought me the silver sickle?

steps.player: Yes, here it is. What are you going to do with it?

steps.npc: My friend, I will bless it for you and you will then be able to accomplish great things. Now then, I must cast the enchantment. You can bless a new sickle by dipping it in the holy water of the grotto.

steps.text: Your sickle has been blessed!  ~ If you lose the blessed sickle, you can bless ~~ a new sickle by dipping it in the grotto waters. ~

steps.npc: Now you can go forth and make the swamp bloom. Collect natures bounty to fill a druids pouch. So armed will the Ghasts be bound to you until, you flee or they are defeated.

Before I can make this grotto into an Altar of Nature, I need to be sure that the Ghasts will be kept at bay. Go forth into Mort Myre and slay three Ghasts. You'll be releasing their souls from Mort Myre.

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Filliman Tarlock
steps.text: I would give you the druid pouch, but you don't seem to have enough space in your inventory.
If the player has one free inventory space:
The nature spirit gives you an empty pouch.

steps.npc: You'll need this in order to collect together natures bounty. When it contains items, it will bind the Ghast to you until you flee or it is defeated.

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-fil.text: This spirit seems too ethereal to communicate with.

entering-filliman-s-grove-subsequent-dia.npc: Hello again my friend, have you defeated three Ghasts as I asked you?
Well, when you do, please come to me and I'll reward you!

options.text: How do I get to attack the Ghasts?

steps.player: How do I get to attack the Ghasts?

steps.npc: Go forth and with the sickle make the swamp bloom. Collect natures bounty to fill a druids pouch. So armed will the Ghasts be bound to you until, you flee or they are defeated.

steps.player: What's this pouch for?

steps.npc: It is for collecting natures bounty, once it contains the blossomed items of the swamp, it will make the Ghasts appear and you can then attack them.

options.text: What can I do with this sickle?

steps.player: What can I do with this sickle?

steps.npc: You may use it wisely within the area of Mort Myre to affect natures balance and bring forth a bounty of natures harvest. Once collected into the druid pouch will the Ghast be apparent.

steps.player: I've lost my sickle!

steps.npc: If you should lose the blessed sickle, simply bring another to my altar of nature and refresh it in the grotto waters.

steps.player: Ok thanks.

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-dre.player: Hiya, I'm a mighty Ghast killer! I've killed [X] so far!

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-dre.speaker: Drezel
entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-dre.text: That's great! How many did Filliman ask you kill?
If the player has killed 1 ghast:

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: So, you've got two more to kill then!

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-dre.text: If the player has killed 2 ghasts:

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: So, you've got one more to kill then!

entering-filliman-s-grove-talking-to-dre.text: If the player has killed 3 ghass:

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: So, you've killed them all then! Go and tell him, I'll bet he'll be pleased.

fighting-the-ghasts.text: If the ghast attacks the player with a filled druid pouch or if the player uses the filled pouch on an invisible ghast:

steps.text: The druid pouch makes the ghast visible.
If there is nothing left in the pouch:
You have nothing left in your druid pouch!

fighting-the-ghasts.text: If the player kills the first visible ghast:

steps.text: That's one Ghast, 2 more to kill.

fighting-the-ghasts.text: If the player kills the second visible ghast:

steps.text: That's two Ghasts, 1 more to kill.

fighting-the-ghasts.text: If the player kills the third visible ghast:

steps.text: That's all three Ghasts!

returning-to-filliman-s-grove.npc: Hello again my friend, have you defeated three Ghasts as I asked you?

returning-to-filliman-s-grove.player: Yes, I've killed all three and their spirits have been released!

returning-to-filliman-s-grove.npc: Many thanks my friend, you have completed your quest! I can now change this place into a holy sanctuary! And forever will it now be an Altar of Nature!
Welcome to my Altar to Nature! Farewell my friend, and keep those Ghasts at bay!

returning-to-filliman-s-grove-attempting.text: This spirit seems to be busy.
